Container.Name: claude
Container.Overview: Claude Code in a tmux session for working on the Unraid plugins. Built locally from docker/claude-code/Dockerfile (no third-party image). Runs as nobody:users, bridge network, no Docker socket. Only /work and the home folder are writable; the server data is mounted read-only. Attach: docker exec -it claude tmux attach -t main, or the Claude button in the Unraid header (Sysbox).

Config.Name: Work (read/write)
Config.Description: Repo and build output. The only place Claude can write besides its home.

Config.Name: Home (login, settings)
Config.Description: Claude Code login and settings (survive updates).

Config.Name: Plugin config (read only)
Config.Description: Installed .plg files and plugin settings. Contains API keys: Claude is told never to print them.

Config.Name: Installed plugin code (read only)
Config.Description: The plugin files as installed, to compare with the repo.

Config.Name: Unraid state (read only)
Config.Description: disks.ini and var.ini for Diskbox checks.
